title: Bouncing Ball
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating basic physics concepts of motion, velocity, and collision detection. Features a ball bouncing within boundaries with user-controllable speed parameter.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Physics
Motion
Velocity
Collision Detection
Kinematics
learningObjectives: Describe how the ball's position updates each animation frame by adding x and y velocity components
Predict the ball's new direction after it collides with a wall, recognizing that the boundary reverses the sign of one velocity component
Explain how the speed slider changes the magnitude of the velocity vector while the bounce angles stay the same
Trace the boundary-detection test that compares the ball's edge position against the canvas walls to trigger a bounce
